Interface IAMRoles

All Known Implementing Classes:
IAMRolesImpl
public interface IAMRoles
Client interface for the IAM roles catalog.

Lists the pre-defined roles available globally (GET /v1/roles, operationId listRoles) or scoped to a project (GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/roles, operationId listRolesByProjectId).

Results are opaque-token paginated: each RoleList carries a nextPageToken; pass it back as the pageToken argument to fetch the next page.

    • list

      RoleList list(String pageToken, Integer pageSize, String projectId, String projectErn)
      Lists all roles, controlling pagination and optional project scoping by id or ERN.

      projectId and projectErn are mutually exclusive — supply at most one.

      Parameters:
      pageToken - the opaque page token from a prior response, or null for the first page
      pageSize - the maximum number of results per page, or null for the server default
      projectId - the project id to scope the listing to (mutually exclusive with projectErn), or null
      projectErn - the project ERN to scope the listing to (mutually exclusive with projectId), or null
      Returns:
      the requested page of roles
